contract.register_permission: A plugin without events permission cannot register a listener
contract.emit_permission: A plugin without events permission cannot emit an event
contract.delivery_isolation: Rejected emits do not deliver events to registered listeners
contract.allowed_delivery: An authorized emitter delivers to the registered listener registry
contract.system_policy: The current EventBus implementation requires events permission for system emit as well
contract.registry_stability: Rejected emits do not mutate the listener registry
contract.source_integrity: Source payloads remain unchanged after authorized or rejected emit attempts
contract.permission_enforcement: EventBus checks the events permission before emit delivery
